phase: Tier 1 quick wins — no new dependencies

pdfToHtml.delivery: single HTML; ZIP with assets only when images are present

pdfToMd.pipeline: pdftotext scanned guard → pdftohtml -s -noframes -i → pandoc gfm

pdf.scannedBehavior: Controlled failure (success=false, output removed) with OCR hint message; never an empty TXT/MD success.

pdfToDocx.reason: No PDF layout extraction adapter; extraction edges are supportsAsIntermediate=false so no mediocre multistep pipeline inflates coverage (§79).

media.remuxPolicy: MKV targets remux (stream copy); MP4/WebM transcode (codec/container incompatible).

imageToPdf.semantics: single image → single-page PDF, page sized to image
imageToPdf.bmp: NOT DECLARED — bmp is not a canonical catalog format and Sharp does not decode BMP in this runtime.
